blocks.x: Right, that’s what I was gonna say, but also you know, he was recording Ravel and putting Ravel with Lush Life together.
And just - I mean everything. His scope was so broad.

Listen. Here’s a guy like - he’s a little elephant guy like Strayhorn, you know. He was very sweet. I know a lot about him, and know some of the stuff that happened to him. He didn’t go out just going out.
Ok, I’ll tell you that if you want it, but you know. So anyway I don’t know the chronology but...
Well maybe it needs to be documented, maybe people need to know.
